name: World Health Organization

flag.description: A light blue field with the white UN emblem, a world map framed by olive branches, overlaid by a gold staff with a serpent coiled round it.
flag.symbolism: The UN emblem marks WHO as part of the UN family, and the serpent-entwined staff of Asclepius is an ancient symbol of medicine.

hook: WHO is the UN flag with a gold snake-wrapped staff standing up through the middle of the world map.
trivia: The emblem was chosen by the first World Health Assembly in 1948.
WHO's constitution came into force on 7 April 1948, the date now marked every year as World Health Day.
